additional_info.subject: ID0480538-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P0 170001113] charger Faulty CRM:03209000247
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0480538
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR
SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Engie Vianeo
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P0 170001113
Charger ID / Serial No.:
SFhfpU
Charger address/functional location: France
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: TF5 check
Following the client’s report and after our internal checks, it is necessary to replace the Wago plug XD10, as I suspect it is the cause of the issue.
As an alternative approach to help identify the root cause during our on-site intervention, we can perform the following actions:
Swap TF5 and TF4 to determine whether the issue remains on Outlet 2 or moves to Outlet 1.
Connect directly to the PLC analog input board to verify whether the problem is related to the wiring.
I also send you the reference of the TF5, in case this needs to be replaced:
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

Après vérification de notre côté, il semblerait que la borne soit entièrement fonctionnelle.

Vous trouverez en pièce jointe une nouvelle capture d’écran sur laquelle aucun flag d’erreur n’apparaît.
Le ticket pourra être clôturé après votre confirmation. Sans retour de votre part d’ici le 03/03, nous procéderons à sa clôture.
Cordialement,
Ramdane Chergui
